messages:
dave_customer: Hey team — since ~09:15 UTC our production API started returning truncated outputs and some requests erroring with 502. Latency also spiked from 120ms to 700ms. This started right after a routing event we saw in our logs. Can you help?

alice_support: Sorry you're hitting this, Dave. Can you paste one X-Request-ID and the model header if available? Any sample requests you can share (sanitized) will help.

dave_customer: Sure — example request id: 01H8X2-9YX. Our app uses region=us-east-1. Curl we sent: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwi-v2","input":"Summarize: ..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate
```
Response headers we received (sanitized):
```
x-request-id: 01H8X2-9YX
x-served-model: rwi-v2-small-quant
status: 200
content-length: 512
```
But the output is garbled and tokens are off (we see broken unicode and tokenization splitting words).

alice_support: Thanks. That x-served-model is telling — it served `rwi-v2-small-quant` instead of `rwi-v2` which can have a different tokenizer/config. I'm going to check routing logs. @bob_sre can you look at regional routing around 09:12-09:20 UTC?

bob_sre: Saw an autoswap triggered by capacity alarm in us-east-1 — deploy-bot posted: 
"deploy-bot: auto-route: us-east-1 -> eu-west-1-backup (policy: surface_burst_fallback)"
We also have a note that the eu-west backup pool has only quantized small variants. That explains the model mismatch + extra latency.

carol_eng: Repro note: small-quant uses a different tokenization table in our packaging (quantized artifact omitted the v2 vocab symlink). That can cause token id drift. We should never fallback to a variant with different tokenizer.

alice_support: That matches what Dave saw. Dave — can you confirm any billing/charge anomalies? Some customers saw duplicate billing while autoswaps occurred.

dave_customer: We saw a few spikes in token counts; our billing dashboard shows unexpected 4x tokens for 09:10-09:25 window. Not sure if retries caused double charging.

amanda_sales: Flagging as customer-impacting — looks like enterprise contract + dedicated capacity for this account. We need timeline and mitigation ASAP.

carol_eng: Mitigation steps: 1) disable cross-region fallback for the customer's routing policy (pin to us-east-1); 2) add a strict model-compatibility check before routing (match tokenizer hash); 3) backfill a migration to ensure eu-west pool has compatible tokenizer artifacts.

alice_support: For immediate workaround we can set route override on their account to prefer exact model id and disallow quantized variants. Dave, can I apply that temporarily?

dave_customer: Please do. Also want a repro path so our QA can validate.

carol_eng: Repro steps for QA:
1) Send request with model=rwi-v2 from us-east region.
2) Simulate capacity by firing 400 concurrent requests to us-east (we used `siege` locally).
3) Watch deploy-bot trigger autoswap to eu-west backup.
4) Observe x-served-model header shows `rwi-v2-small-quant` and tokenizer mismatch appears in output.

Example check command: 
```
# produce a single failing response header
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -d '{"model":"rwi-v2","input":"tokenization test: café — résumé"}' https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate | head -n 20
```

bob_sre: Created alert rule change PR to prevent autoswap to pools with incompatible artifact labels. Also adding an immediate firewall rule to stop cross-region routing for affected customers until artifact parity is fixed.

alice_support: I've applied the route override for Dave's account (account_id: acct-08X). Please verify.

dave_customer: Confirmed — responses now come from `rwi-v2` and tokenization looks normal. Latency back to ~140ms. Thanks.

carol_eng: We'll ship a validation check and patch the eu-west pool artifact sync. Follow-up ticket: INF-1428 (internal) — will include postmortem and billing reconciliation.

amanda_sales: I'll coordinate credits for the customer while eng completes postmortem.

alice_support: Closing the urgent loop here. Dave, we'll share the postmortem and billing adjustments when ready. :thumbsup: 

dave_customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please include steps we can run to detect tokenization drift automatically.

carol_eng: We'll add a small token-consistency test to the SDK health checks and include it in the postmortem.

deploy-bot: autoswap-log: 2019-10-02T09:12:14Z -> triggered surface_burst_fallback for us-east-1; destination eu-west-1-backup (variants: rwi-v2-small-quant)

alice_support: Marking thread resolved for now. Will reopen if anything else crops up.
